messages:
ben_sales: Ping @olive_security @maya_privacy — EU Clinical POC needs completed SIG/CAIQ rows + a one-line DSAR/deletion row per telemetry type. Deadline: Tue COB CET. Can we produce a compact CSV they can paste into procurement?

olive_security: Yep. Need to confirm which telemetry they care about: request logs, metrics, embeddings, prompt-logs (debug), and KV snapshots.

maya_privacy: For GDPR DSARs: we should state controller vs processor, include subprocessors, and give an SLA. For POC I suggest: ack 48h, export within 20 days, deletion attested within 5 business days.

oscar_infra: Infra defaults for trials: logs=21d, metrics=90d, embeddings=60d, prompts(debug)=7d. We can shorten retention per-customer and pin region to eu-west-1. Embeddings and logs are encrypted at rest (KMS).

olive_security: I'll drop a compact mapping below (CSV-style) with CAIQ refs and short deletion artifacts column — short labels to fit a cell.

```
telemetry,store,region,encryption,access,retention_days,deletion_artifacts,caiq_ref
request_logs,S3:proj-logs,eu-west-1,KMS,rbac+audit,21,s3-delete-marker;purge-log,SC-8
metrics,TSDB,eu-west-1,disk-enc,svc-roles,90,retention-policy-log,CM-2
embeddings,enc-db,eu-west-1,KMS,restricted-acl,60,db-tombstone;purge-log,DP-3
prompts(debug),ephemeral,eu-west-1,KMS,limited,7,cron-purge-log;blob-delete,AP-4
kv-snapshots,mem-snap,eu-west-1,NA,devops-only,0 (ephemeral),snapshot-delete-note,aud-1
```

olive_security: Note: "deletion_artifacts" can be S3 delete markers, purge job logs, DB tombstones, and an attestation PDF from Legal. We can also provide a signed manifest (sha256) on request.

maya_privacy: DPA sentence for paste: "Redwood will not use POC customer telemetry, prompts, or embeddings for model training or improvement without explicit written opt-in; retention and deletion will follow the POC onboarding configuration and the DSAR runbook provided."

oscar_infra: I'll prepare sanitized examples (s3-delete-marker.txt, purge_job_sample.log, db_tombstone_sample.json) and pin the POC to eu-west-1 with VPC endpoints.

legal-bot: ACTION: attach poc_trial_dpa_addendum and subprocessors_declaration when sending. Use template link: https://redwood.example.com/legal/poc_trial_dpa

ben_sales: Perfect 95 I'll send to the customer with the CSV and DPA sentence, and schedule a 30-min walkthrough Tue 10:00 CET. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

(edited)
